correctness.rationale: The exact finite prefix and periodic block are reconstructed from residue slices modulo six. Restricted interval arithmetic produces exact affine formulas for all distinct triple sums of C and distinct pairs of C plus B. An exact partition of (h,11h+3] proves the finite base. Modular disjointness of 2C+R, C+2R and 3R prevents any periodic member from being a forbidden triple; shifting the largest periodic summand yields an infinite covering induction. The unique 4h-6 gap proves the least eventual period. Standalone symbolic checker verifies all affine comparisons for every k>=2; direct independent bitset enumeration corroborates 399 parameter values and longer windows.

value.rationale: The motivating recent preprint frames ultimate periodicity of strict greedy three-sumfree sequences as a central open problem and proves only a restricted parameter region plus finite examples. An explicit, natural h=6k+5 infinite seed line outside its general theorem, with exact full membership, least period and density, has structural value and is not implied by individual census cases. It offers a useful restricted-sumset interval mechanism for other seed families.
